reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.70% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +5bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+1.1pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 12bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 147 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 94 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 16.1 sits at the 27th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 8.9, so implied carries +7.2 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: CoreWeave's interest bill jumps toward $860-940M for Q3 as refinancing risk on $51.6B debt stack draws scrutiny
items.note: Analysts flag CoreWeave's Q2 interest expense of $640M (guided to $860-940M in Q3) against its debt load just as the 10-year Treasury sits at a cycle-high 4.80% and rate-hike odds creep back into pricing, versus Nebius's ~$8B cash and prepayment-funded capex — a widening credit-quality gap within the neocloud cohort, not yet a realized event.

items.headline: Oracle Q1 FY2027 beats on revenue and EPS, but capex hits $28.5B and free cash flow swings to -$5.4B
items.note: Cloud infrastructure revenue surged 121% and RPO backlog grew to $664B, but capex jumped from $8.5B to $28.5B y/y, driving free cash flow to -$5.4B (from -$362M a year ago) on a debt load of ~$125B; the beat resolves the pending item from the prior scan without changing the underlying cash-burn-funds-AI-buildout thesis.

items.headline: SoftBank confirms early payoff of $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan, launches $10-20B junk-bond roadshow
items.note: SoftBank must retire the $25.9B outstanding balance on its $40B OpenAI-investment bridge loan by Sept 15 and is meeting investors Sept 14-17 to test demand for a $10-20B BB+-rated dollar/euro junk-bond sale — a concrete sign the OpenAI bet is being pushed onto high-yield markets rather than absorbed on balance sheet.
